data_infos.etl_description: Fetch the two live MOL OAS JSON resources with a browser User-Agent. Resolve columns by semantic aliases, convert ROC year to AD, parse commas and missing dashes, output mean/rate/median with all contract columns, and reconcile every selected numeric source cell to an emitted fact. The current structured resource is 114 only; historical 110-114 official PDFs are documented but not silently mixed into this machine-readable DAG.
